_readme: Running weighted-average-cost ledger. Each key is a SKU; each entry is a dated cost
batch on top of the SKU's existing baseline LANDED_COST (which the pipeline treats as
an implicit 'opening' batch, back-dated to 2026-01-01, whose qty is backed out live as
current total_inv (AZ+WH) minus the qty of every batch listed here - so it never needs
manual upkeep). To record a NEW batch in future (another shipment, a cost change,
etc.), add one object to that SKU's list with:
date              - ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the batch takes effect. Sales on/after
this date use the new blended WAC; sales before it don't.
qty               - units received in this batch.
landed_cost_aed   - this batch's own fully-loaded cost per unit, AED (product cost
+ all freight/duty/VAT for that batch specifically - NOT a WAC).
The pipeline (dashboard_refresh_data.py) then computes the running WAC for any date
as the qty-weighted average of every batch (opening + ledger) dated on or before it.
See UK_Batch_Costing_and_Revised_WAC_v3.xlsx for the full worked calculation behind
